tagline: A leading mortgage REIT focused on residential mortgage-backed securities and mortgage servicing rights
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross margin slightly improving due to a stabilized rate environment, reflecting the performance of the residential mortgage-backed securities portfolio

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on fixed assets to maintain or expand operations.
kpis.description: As a REIT focused on mortgage-backed securities, Annaly does not make significant capital investments in physical infrastructure.
kpis.signal: Capex near zero, consistent with an asset management-focused REIT model

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income and cost of funds, expressed as a percentage of total revenues.
kpis.description: Gross margin reflects the performance of the residential mortgage-backed securities and residential loan portfolio.
kpis.signal: Margin slightly improving due to a stabilized rate environment

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenues.
kpis.description: Operating margin includes general and administrative expenses, which are relatively stable for an asset management REIT structure.
kpis.signal: Modest improvement in operating profitability reflecting better control of overhead expenses

kpis.name: R&D spending (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Annaly does not allocate budget to R&D, as its business is based on financial asset management rather than technological product development.
kpis.signal: No significant R&D spending, consistent with the REIT model

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of full-time equivalent employees.
kpis.description: Headcount reflects a lean, optimized structure focused on financial asset management.
kpis.signal: Slight reduction in headcount in line with cost optimization

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $2.027 Bn for the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.description: Diluted EPS extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Diluted EPS of $2.92 for the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total assets of $135.61 Bn for the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

ai_positioning.summary: Annaly Capital Management does not reference any artificial intelligence initiatives in its financial filings or recent communications. Its business relies on traditional management of real estate and financial asset portfolios.
evidence: No mention of AI in the 2025 10-K
No reference to automated analytics or machine learning tools
Absence of KPIs or strategy related to digitalization or technological innovation
